ModMetadata.Name: Sage
ModMetadata.Author: dtandersen
ModMetadata.Description:
Sage is an assistant for Stationeers. Ask it questions in chat (@sage) or the console (ai) and it reads live game data — items, structures, recipes, Stationpedia pages, inventory, and position — before answering.
This is a BepInEx plugin mod. It runs as a plain BepInEx plugin and as a StationeersLaunchPad Local mod. It needs BepInEx 5. LaunchPad is only needed for the Local mod path.
Set AI/ApiKey in the BepInEx config before use. Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint works. See: https://github.com/dtandersen/stationeers-mods
ModMetadata.ChangeLog: 0.1.0 - First packaged release: BepInEx plugin + LaunchPad Local mod layouts.
